xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Office of the Commissioner of Custom (Preventive), Jodhpur under Customs Act.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Company has received a demand through adjudication order from the Commissioner of Customs (Preventive), Jodhpur amounting to Rs. 70.10 Cr. (excluding interest, fine and penalty) for not meeting pre-import condition during the period from October 2017 to January 2019 in respect of certain imports under advance authorization scheme of the Director General of Foreign Trade.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The Company has filed an appeal before Hon'ble CESTAT on 04.09.23 and matter is pending for disposal at this stage.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Company has received notice of demand under section 156 of the Income-Tax Act, 1961 (“the Act”) raising demand of ₹ 41.49 Cr. (Tax - ₹ 30.01 Cr. and Interest - ₹ 11.48 Cr.) pursuant to the assessment order passed by the Assessment Unit, Income Tax Department under Section 143(3) of the Act dated March 25, 2025 for the Assessment Year 2022-23.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The Company, based on its preliminary assessment, believes that it has a good case on merits and is confident of a favorable outcome at the appellate stage. The status as on the reporting date is that the company is in the process of adopting following course of Action: - Appeal Before NFAC delhi - Application of stay of demand before High Pitch demand committee of Income tax department. - Rectification application for order for correction of mistakes apparent from record in the demand notice.
